entity.elemental.chronicle_guide.name: Aeron, the Last Skywright
tooltip.elemental.jetpack.desc: Forged with salvaged Skyforge avionics and buoyant aerogel.
tooltip.elemental.jetpack.toggle: ► Press [`] to toggle the jetpack on/off.
tooltip.elemental.jetpack.thrust: ► Hold [Space] airborne to thrust at Elytra speed in your look direction.

dialogue.elemental.aeron.busy: Aeron is speaking... (Right-click him or click [Skip] to skip)
dialogue.elemental.aeron.too_far: You are too far from Aeron to speak with him.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.reminder_ship: Search the crashed Skyforge ship nearby. Recover the blueprints and components, then bring them back to me.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.reminder_desert: The desert. The ancient domed sanctuary is charted at [X: %d, Z: %d]. Follow your compass waypoint across the dunes.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.elements: Dry Heat, Snow, Tree, Ocean, Mountain, and Nether Fire. Each has its own domain—and its own dangers. The Core once kept them in balance.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.solvane: He was once a guardian of the elements. Now the fragment inside him keeps him alive, and twists everything it touches.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.terrakon: A colossus buried beneath the world. The Core’s power woke it, and the mountains have been trembling ever since.
dialogue.elemental.choice.help: Can you help me fight them?
dialogue.elemental.aeron.help: I can give you knowledge. The rest you’ll have to forge for yourself.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase1_1: Easy… you’re awake. Can you stand?
dialogue.elemental.player.phase1_2: I think so. What happened here? This world looks corrupted.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase1_3: It is. The land is still here, but the power that held it in balance has been shattered.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase1_5: The Elemental Core. It once carried the strength of all six elements: Dry Heat, Snow, Tree, Ocean, Mountain, and Nether Fire.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase1_7: The Core broke into six fragments. Three were absorbed by Sir Solvane—the Everliving Knight. The other three were taken by Terrakon, the Seismic Colossus.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase1_9: Perhaps. But not by force alone. The fragments must be recovered, and the Core’s power must be restored before either guardian can be defeated.
dialogue.elemental.player.phase1_10: Why are you telling me this?
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase1_11: Because you’re still standing. And the broken forge at your side… it may be the beginning of a way forward. You’ll need to become an Element-Smith.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase1_13: First, you need a way to reach places the old roads cannot. There’s a crashed Skyforge ship on a high cliff nearby. Its artificers were building something that could carry them through the sky. Search the wreckage for its 4 recipe maps and flight schematics. Bring them back to me.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase1_15: Bring back what you find. I’ll help you understand it.
dialogue.elemental.player.phase2_1: I found the 4 recipe maps for the jetpack in the wreckage.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase2_2: Let me see… These are flight schematics. A jetpack—an artificer’s device for rising, hovering, and crossing the highlands.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase2_4_tasks_: I can decipher the blueprints, but assembling an Elemental Jetpack requires a true Element-Smith. There are four tasks to construct it:
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase2_5_task1: Task 1: Craft a Pneumatic Piston! It provides the high-pressure compression needed for thrust. Check your recipe guide—I've decoded the method for you!
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase2_6: There! A little rough around the edges, but it should carry you skyward. Treat it well—and watch your fuel.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase2_6_alread: There! I see you already carry an Elemental Jetpack! Treat it well—and watch your fuel.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase2_8: The desert village. Seek out the Desert Village across the dunes. There you will find Eldrin, the Elemental Wizard—an ancient scholar who knows every element, every weapon, and the guardians of old. Let your jetpack guide you through the skies.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.phase2_10: Go, Element-Smith. The world is waiting to be mended.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.task2_assigned: §6[Aeron] §eFirst component ready! Task 2: Craft an Aerogel Core! Combine glass, feathers, and a catalyst (snowball, slime ball, or quartz) to cushion the air intake.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.task3_element_c: §6[Aeron] §eSplendid! Task 3: Craft an Element Core! Keep this in mind: Element Cores are a commonly used resource in almost all artificer recipes. Make a handful of them—you will need plenty in your journey!
dialogue.elemental.aeron.task4_assigned: §6[Aeron] §eAll components are ready! Task 4: Assemble your Elemental Jetpack at a crafting table using 4 Pneumatic Pistons, 2 Aerogel Cores, and 1 Element Core!
dialogue.elemental.aeron.jetpack_complet: §6[Aeron] §a§lMagnificent! You've forged an authentic Elemental Jetpack! Equip it to your chestplate slot to soar through the skies. Now head out across the dunes to the Desert Village to find the Elemental Wizard!
dialogue.elemental.aeron.remind_task1: Task 1: Craft a Pneumatic Piston using iron ingots, copper ingots, a piston, and redstone at a crafting table.
dialogue.elemental.aeron.remind_task2: Task 2: Craft an Aerogel Core using glass, feathers, and a lightweight catalyst (snowball, slime ball, or quartz).
dialogue.elemental.aeron.remind_task3: Task 3: Craft an Element Core using copper ingots or cobblestone around coal. Remember, it's a commonly used resource, so make a handful of them!
dialogue.elemental.aeron.remind_task4: Task 4: Assemble your Elemental Jetpack at a crafting table with 4 Pneumatic Pistons, 2 Aerogel Cores, and 1 Element Core.

entity.elemental.elemental_wizard.name: Eldrin, the Elemental Wizard
dialogue.elemental.wizard.intro_1: Greetings, traveler of the skies. The roar of the Skyforge thrusters echoes an age long past. I am Eldrin, Scholar of the Primal Spheres.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.intro_2: Aeron guided me here. He said you hold the knowledge of all weapons, elements, and bosses.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.intro_3: He speaks true. I have spent lifetimes chronicling the six primal elements, the sacred weapons forged from them, and the ancient guardians that now corrupt our realm.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.intro_4: Neither Sir Solvane nor the Seismic Colossus can be felled by ordinary steel. If you are to mend this broken world, you must forge your first elemental weapon.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.intro_5: To begin, I have engraved the forgotten recipe of the Element Core into your memory. It is the vessel required to capture primal energy.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.task1_assign: Your first task: Normal crafting tables cannot withstand elemental forging. Gather 3 Iron Ingots and 4 Smooth Stone, and craft a Weaponer workstation!
dialogue.elemental.wizard.task1_done: Remarkable work! The Weaponer is ready to shape raw primal forces into tangible artifacts.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.task2_assign: Task Two: Infuse the Dry Heat Element. Craft an Element Core, harvest a Cactus from these scorched dunes, and place them into the Weaponer to extract the element!
dialogue.elemental.wizard.task1_reminder: To build your Weaponer, gather 3 Iron Ingots and 4 Smooth Stone, then craft it at any workbench.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.task2_done: Feel that intense warmth? The Dry Heat Element radiates with solar fury.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.multiple_eleme: A vital tip, Element-Smith: Make multiple Element Cores and extra Elements whenever you gather materials! You will need them to activate sacred boss altars and forge future weapons.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.task3_assign: Task Three: Forge your first weapon—the Sunforged Scimitar! Craft a Stencil (Iron, Gold, and an Element Core), then fuse it with your Dry Heat Element in the Weaponer!
dialogue.elemental.wizard.task2_reminder: Place an Element Core and a harvested Cactus into your Weaponer to synthesize the Dry Heat Element.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.task3_done_1: By the sacred dawn... The Sunforged Scimitar has been forged anew!
dialogue.elemental.wizard.task3_done_2: Its edge is tempered by pure solar heat. When swung, it unleashes sweeping Solar Arcs that slice through foes and burn them to cinder.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.task3_done_3: You have proven yourself a true Element-Smith. Speak with me anytime to learn about other elements, weapons, or the guardians you must confront!
dialogue.elemental.wizard.task3_reminder: Combine a Weapon Stencil and the Dry Heat Element in your Weaponer to forge the Sunforged Scimitar.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.snow_reminder: Journey to snowy biomes or glacial peaks to harvest Snow Blocks and craft the Snow Element in your Weaponer.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.tree_reminder: Seek out the dense dark forest canopy to harvest dark wood for your Tree Element in your Weaponer.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.arena_reminder: The Everliving Coliseum lies marked by your waypoint guidance. Tread carefully; Sir Solvane shows no mercy.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.boss_intro_1: Outstanding mastery! All three primal arms—the Sunforged Scimitar, Frostwake Pick, and Rootbound Axe—are in your hands!
dialogue.elemental.wizard.boss_intro_2: With Sun, Ice, and Wood reunited, the ancient seal on the celestial arena has shattered.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.boss_intro_3: Now arrives your first true trial: Sir Solvane, the Everliving Knight!
dialogue.elemental.wizard.boss_intro_4: He guards the first Core in the Sacred Coliseum. Follow the waypoint guidance, place your elemental offerings upon his altar, and bring honor to the Element-Smiths!
dialogue.elemental.wizard.greeting_compl: Welcome back, Element-Smith. What knowledge of the spheres and weapons do you seek today?
dialogue.elemental.wizard.task_general_h: Continue your journey by consulting the Weaponer recipes and seeking out the remaining elemental sources across the land.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.too_far: Eldrin is too far away to hear you.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.choice_header: Ask Eldrin about the lore of the realm:
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_dry_heat: The Dry Heat Element draws from burning sunbeams and desert sands. It powers solar flames, burning auras, and blinding radiant cuts.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_snow: The Snow Element embodies perpetual glacial frost. Infusing it slows adversaries to a crawl and shatters rigid defenses.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_tree: The Tree Element channels root-bound organic resilience from dark forests, binding enemies in briars and granting life-giving regeneration.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_ocean: The Ocean Element channels deep-sea water pressure. It creates protective hydro-bubbles and propels the wielder in surging tidal rushes.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_mountain: The Mountain Element originates in towering calcite peaks and bedrock. It shatters the earth, unleashing thunderous aerial shockwaves that fling foes.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_fire: The Nether Fire Element is forged in the magma depths of the underworld. It rips holes in space-time, opening devastating rift collapses.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_scimitar: The Sunforged Scimitar: A fast curved scimitar of Dry Heat. Slashes discharge piercing Solar Arcs that incinerate multiple foes in a straight line.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_pick: The Frostwake Pick: A glacial pickaxe and weapon that freezes blocks and mobs on impact, breaking impenetrable barriers.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_axe: The Rootbound Axe: A heavy timber cleaver that sunders armor, summons grasping roots from the soil, and heals its wielder.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_trident: The Tidebreaker Trident: Can be hurled or jabbed. Encapsulates enemies in pressurized bubbles and executes swift waterborne lunges.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_hammer: The Stormcaller Hammer: A colossal maul. Falling from heights multiplies its impact, slamming the ground in explosive seismic shockwaves.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_rift_blad: The Ashen Rift Blade: The pinnacle greatsword of the Nether. Tears reality to draw meteors and open cataclysmic dark-flame rifts.
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_solvane: Sir Solvane, the Everliving Knight: Master of three Core fragments. Clad in eternal armor, he wields blazing martial dashes and solar blasts. Evade his sweeping charges with your Jetpack!
dialogue.elemental.wizard.info_terrakon: Terrakon, the Seismic Colossus: An ancient earthen titan bearing the other three Core fragments. He hurls boulders, summons stone minions, and fractures the ground with tectonic slams.
enchantment.elemental.solar_blast.desc: Solar Arc strikes occasionally intensify into an explosive Solar Blast with amplified damage and multi-target detonation.
enchantment.elemental.dawns_siphon.desc: Striking enemies in sunlight or at high heat infuses blows with solar fire, mends blade durability, and grants temporary fire resistance.
enchantment.elemental.spike_shockwave.de: Glacial Shockwave bursts into concentric rings of erupting ice spikes that launch mobs into the air while preserving deep frost.
enchantment.elemental.timber_bastion.des: Pressing [R] summons a temporary organic log wall to shield against attacks, with a chance to bestow Regeneration.
enchantment.elemental.tidal_ram.desc: Tidebreaker Dash crashes violently through mobs in your path, dealing heavy hydro-kinetic damage and shoving them aside.
enchantment.elemental.thunderous_descent: Multiplies melee hammer damage based on falling height, with higher levels guaranteeing devastating aerial slam attacks.
enchantment.elemental.cataclysmic_rift.d: Rift Collapse has a chance to summon a blazing falling meteorite down onto the collapsed ground for catastrophic blast damage.
